details.publicNotes:
Sirenspiders are deadly, otherworldly predators that lure in prey with haunting melodies that flow through their hollow, metallic bodies before paralyzing and devouring them.

Young sirenspiders hunt with their siblings. As they mature, the pitches of the spiders gradually diverge from each other, and when this dissonance becomes sufficiently discordant, the enraged spiders rip their siblings apart until only the strongest survive, nesting and making melodies together.

Luring Song

A sirenspider's musical arrangements exhibit remarkable sophistication for a barely sapient creature, and they sometimes spread far beyond the spider's lair. One enterprising composer even made a living scribing the siren's melodies and turning them into orchestral performances for rapt audiences, claiming that you can't plagiarize an unintelligent creature. To no one's surprise, he came to a bad end: caught in the spell of the music, he was devoured by his own muse.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 810/1,850/3,400 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing), armor (light, heavy), shield, perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance, Stealth)

Eligible Imbued Properties body, bane, charisma, dexterity, elongating, energy resistant (fire, vitality), metal, music, sensory (darkvision), strength, sturdy, throwing, wild

description.value: A creature hit by the sirenspider's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} and tethered to the sirenspider, preventing it from moving farther away from the sirenspider. The sirenspider can have one creature tethered at a time. The DC to [[/act escape dc=36]] or [[/act force-open dc=36]] the web is 36. The tether can be severed with a Strike (AC 20, Hardness 5, HP 30), but this doesn't free the restrained creature.

Trigger The sirenspider is within the area of an auditory effect

Effect The sirenspider's carapace resonates with the sound, amplifying it. The area of the triggering effect extends to include a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around the sirenspider. In addition, if the effect requires a saving throw and the sirenspider rolls a success, they get a critical success instead.

Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} creature is within the sirenspider's reach

Effect The sirenspider sinks their fangs into the creature to draw out its vital essence. The sirenspider attempts an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, and the sirenspider gains 20 temporary Hit Points. Draining Essence from a creature that's already drained and stupefied increases the value of one of the conditions of the sirenspider's choice (to a maximum of 4). A victim's stupefied condition decreases by 1 per hour.

The sirenspider emits an entrancing melody. Each non-sirenspider creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save. The effect lasts until the end of the sirenspider's next turn, but the sirenspider can Sustain it. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the sirenspider for 1 round.

Failure The creature is fascinated with the sirenspider and must spend each of its actions on its turn to move closer to the sirenspider as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a fascinated creature is adjacent to the sirenspider, it stays still and doesn't act. If the creature is attacked, the fascination ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the fascination doesn't automatically end if the creature is attacked. Instead, the creature can attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save each time it is attacked to end the fascination.

The sirenspider's metallic carapace chimes with a melody pitched to immobilize its prey. Each non-sirenspider creature within 15 feet of the sirenspider must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is paralyzed for 3 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, the creature can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.
